factor_name: 40-day vol-scaled z-score of price vs SMA40

calculation.description: Vol-scaled distance of close from its trailing 40-day simple moving average, normalized by 60-day return volatility. Longer-horizon, slower-turning trend/level factor.

metrics.note: Passes IC/ICIR admission gates; time-averaged cross-sectional Spearman vs library max_abs_mean_rho=0.846 (sharpe_20). Redundancy adjudicated by post-Miner gate from signal artifacts.

validation.regime_notes: Full-sample validation incl. 2020 crash, 2021 bull, 2022 bear, 2023-24 choppy, 2025-26 rally; artifacts through 2026-09-23 (fresh, not clamped). Regime ICs recorded in metrics.
